title: Debias-CLR: A Contrastive Learning Based Debiasing Method for Algorithmic Fairness in Healthcare Applications
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on mitigating gender and ethnicity biases in healthcare AI models.
